plainTranslation: With Composite Mercury in the 9th house, you can have light-hearted communication about subjects that interest you and expand your minds with one another. This can be excellent for a relationship based on study and learning. You can enjoy expressing yourselves with one another, and can focus on the positives of the relationship, but you may have a hard time focusing on more serious stuff, so you have to make sure you’re not trying to avoid that on purpose.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
